# Introduction

------------------------------------------------------------------------

The metrics compared are:

-   mean of median grey: the higher the value, the clearer
-   carbon content from McConville et al. (2017), group communications by Julie Lemoine: the lower the value, the more gelatinuous

For the class average grey levels, they are calculated as density-adjusted mean of all objects per class.

# Data

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## In situ grey levels

```{r}
# data 
sp <- read_csv(file.path(cfg$project$data,"imagery_zooscan_samples+acquisitions_cleaned.csv"))
obj <- read_csv(file.path(cfg$project$data,"imagery_zooscan_objects_morpho_taxo_cleaned.csv")) %>% 
  left_join(select(sp,sampleid,acquisid,d)) 

# calculate the mean per class/phylum
class_mean <- obj %>% 
  group_by(class_phylum) %>% 
  summarize(all_class_mean=sum(grey_median*d)/sum(d),
            sd=sd(grey_median),
            n=n()) %>%
  mutate(se = sd / sqrt(n),
         t_crit = qt(0.975, df = n - 1),  # 95% CI critical value
            lower_ci = all_class_mean - t_crit * se,
            upper_ci = all_class_mean + t_crit * se)
```

## McConville

```{r}
# McConville et al (2017) - from Julie Lemoine and supplementary materials
mcconville <- tibble(
  class_phylum = c("Copepoda", "Chaetognatha", "Hydrozoa", "Scyphozoa",
                   "Ctenophora", "Appendicularia", "Thaliacea", "Gastropoda",
                   "Malacostraca", "Ostracoda", "Cephalopoda", "Annelida"),
  value = c(9.48, 3.56, 0.384141406, 0.491428569, 0.205286, 0.07,
                  1.081628667, 5.52, 9.64, 4.758, 13.41, 5.2),
    type = "% gelatinuous (McConville et al. 2017)") %>%
  # transform %carbon into %gelatinuous
  mutate(value=100-value)
```

# Comparison Plot

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Test avec une autre facon de calculer, sans passer par les échantillons:

```{r}
compare <- class_mean %>% left_join(mcconville) %>% drop_na(value)
```

```{r}
compare %>% 
    ggplot(aes(x=value, y=all_class_mean,color=reorder(class_phylum,value))) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=lower_ci, ymax=upper_ci), width=0.1) + # Vertical error bars
    geom_smooth(method="lm",se=FALSE,color="grey",linetype="dashed") + 
    stat_cor(label.x=87,label.y=200) +
    stat_regline_equation(label.x=87, label.y=210) + 
    scale_color_manual(values = c(
  "#B22222",
  "#0072B2",
  "#E69F00",
  "#009E73",
  "#CC79A7",
  "#D55E00",
  "#56B4E9",
  "#F0E442",
  "#000000",
  "#999999",
  "#882255",
  "#44AA99"
)) + 
    guides(color = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE)) + 
    theme_classic() +
    labs(x="% gelatinuous (McConville et al. 2017)",y="Average organism median grey",color="",shape="") + 
    theme(legend.position="right",
          text=element_text(size=15)) # Adjust legend position if needed
```
